helpers.name: ActorEvent_ReinitializeInteractionResponse
effects: preserve actor field +0x06 bit 3 across template initialization
set actor byte +0x09 to 0xFF when FRAME_PHASE_COUNTER bit 0 is set

helpers.name: ActorEvent_SpawnCollisionResponseChild
helpers.condition: FRAME_PHASE_COUNTER low three bits equal 1 and Actor_FindFreeSlotForward succeeds
effects: set child actor flags field +0x06 to 0x40
copy source X and source Y plus 10

boundary_basis: The reinitialization helper ends after the return-trampoline write and RTS at 0x001ACB58-0x001ACB59.
The child-spawn helper ends at its D0 restore and RTS immediately before ActorEvent_CopyLinkedActorCoordinates at 0x001ACBD8.
